keyVerseDR: "I am come to cast fire on the earth. And what will I, but that it be kindled?" (Lk 12:49)

level1.title: Fire of Love
level1.story: Jesus said, "I came to bring fire to the earth!" He wanted everyone's heart to burn with love for God. Following Jesus is not always easy.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus come to light?
How can your heart be on fire for God?
level1.prayer: Jesus, set my heart on fire. Amen.

activity.title: A burning heart
activity.intro: Color the flame of the candle. Let your heart burn with love for Jesus!

level2.title: Fire on the Earth
level2.story: Jesus said, "I am come to cast fire on the earth; and what will I, but that it be kindled?" He said He had a baptism to be baptized with, speaking of His Passion. Jesus said that following Him would bring division, even in families. Some would choose Him and some would not. Jesus wants our hearts to burn with love for God above all things.
level2.keyLine: I am come to cast fire on the earth.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why can following Jesus be hard with others?
level2.prayer: Jesus, kindle the fire of Your love in me. Amen.

activity.title: What is zeal?
activity.intro: Jesus wanted hearts on fire with love. Explain in your own words.
starters: My heart burns for Jesus when...
I can share God's love by...

art.mainBrief: Jesus with a small fire lighting hearts
